text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A-A birthday present, for someone like 
me!? Wh-Wh-Whaaaat~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's a beckoning cat I got at a spiritual 
hotspot in the south. I just hope you 
don't already have one...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A spiritual hotspot in the south...? And 
this bell chime, this weight...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
C-Could it be!? Is that an 
ultra-super-rare beckoning cat that's 
almost impossible to find!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~, thank you so much! I'm so, so 
happy~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. I'm just glad I could hand it 
over without causing you any trouble...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh my? There seems to be a scrap of 
paper in the box...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Doto-san! A receipt was stuck to you!
